items.title: Sheep+
items.creator: Lifeboat
items.description:
Craft new sheep with almost any material! Breed different types, like TNT and Gunpowder sheep. Find them in the Overworld, Nether, and The End. Shear them to harvest their blocks or items. Some have unique properties. Watch out when you shear the lava type.
- 47 new sheep types
- Breeding mechanics
- Craft them
- 5 skins

The sheer audacity of it all!

items.title: Pop It
items.creator: Lifeboat
items.description:
Pop bubbles and relieve stress! Enjoy the sensory feel and sound of each pop. Have fun avoiding traps and solving puzzles that unlock secret rooms. Earn trophies or just enjoy the relaxing environment.
- 4 engaging levels
- Pop its, spinners, and other fidget toys
- Touch-screen friendly
- 5 skins

Play with fidget toys in Minecraft!

items.title: Trendy Rainbow Teens
items.creator: House of How
items.description: Colorful, cute and trendy, these skins are all something to show off! Pick your favorite, unique rainbow outfit and wow your friends! 9 Skins to choose from!

items.title: Clash
items.creator: Shapescape
items.description:
Assemble your troops, put on your armor, weapons, and battle face, and get ready to command battles unlike any other! Fight bosses or challenge your friends to see who is the best battlefield commander! Will you be the one to lead your medieval army to victory? Find out in 70+ possible scenarios!

+ 4 bosses!
+ 10+ arenas!
+ PvP, PvE & Sandbox mode!
+ Single & Multiplayer!

items.title: RGB Skins
items.creator: Magefall
items.description:
These cyberwave inspired skins are bursting with bright neon colors! With abstract patterns and cool color combos, find the perfect skin that suits you!

- 8 RGB skins!
- Pick from many different designs and stand out from any crowd!

items.title: Devil's Castle
items.creator: CrackedCubes
items.description:
Updated to 1.20! Travel back to fantasy times and experience the thrill of being a devil in your own faraway lava-filled realm, nestled within the tranquil overworld.

+ New and upgraded devil-themed skins
+ Huge new custom lava terrain with the iconic castle
+ New unique custom textures and custom automations

From the team at CrackedCubes
items.changelog: We've brought a few new updates to Devil's Castle for you to enjoy: + Castle upgraded to the latest 1.20 update + New lava-themed custom terrain + Updated skins (and three additional new skins) + New unique custom devil-themed textures + Unique custom gate automations Have fun exploring!

items.title: One Block Hacker Tools
items.creator: Fall Studios
items.description:
Skyblock is too easy for you? Then try your hand at the One Block Challenge!
Whenever you mine the block you get a random item or block!

+ Hacker Tools located in the chests around the map!
items.changelog:
Update 1.1
- Added more islands to the world
- Added more op loot to the chests
- Updated the One Block to version 26.10

items.title: Knights vs Mobs- Tower Defense
items.creator: UUUM
items.description:
A tower defense game supervised by Kazu is here!
Protect the kingdom from imminent monsters, evil knights and dragons!

- Multiplayer support!
- Original and unique monsters!
- No rules! Use your skills to the fullest and fight as you like!

- Superviser: Kazu
- Production: Japan Crafters Union

items.title: Liberation of Alba Castle
items.creator: Impress
items.description:
This island is overrun by monsters.
You become an adventurer and must defeat the boss in the castle!
- Rank displayed for speed runs and enemy count
- Choose from three dificulties
- A fantasy world where you fight original monsters
Creator: Team- Kyo

items.title: Playerz vs Hackerz
items.creator: CrackedCubes
items.description:
Battle your friends as either playerz or hackerz! Perfect for multi-player competitions, pick which team you belong to and defend your realm! Which side will win? One free skin included.
From the team at CrackedCubes

items.title: Pumpkin Family
items.creator: PixelOneUp
items.description: Calling all jack-o'-lanterns! Choose your favorite pumpkin to get the mission done. Go blend in with these unique skins!

items.title: Blocks
items.creator: Mine-North
items.description:
Play as a block and hide from your friends with the block skins.

+ Free skin
+ Blocks
+ Diamond

Created by Mine-North

items.title: Cyberpunk Teens
items.creator: Mine-North
items.description:
Take your favourite skin and roleplay with your friends. Build your own cyber empire. 

+ Free skin
+ Cyberpunk
+ Teens

Created by Mine-North

items.title: Hip Hop
items.creator: Impulse
items.description:
Pop and lock in these trendy hip hop skins! Show off your style and music with your friends!

+ 12 skins to choose from!

items.title: Anime Idols 5
items.creator: DogHouse
items.description:
How cool would it be to experience new minecraft adventures as your favourite anime character? This pack makes it possible!

-12 skins
-perfect for roleplay
-have fun!

items.title: Lucky Block Parkour City
items.creator: 100Media
items.description:
Lucky blocks? Parkour? LUCKY BLOCK PARKOUR CITY! Travel throughout the infinite parkour while achieving lucky blocks on your way to help you out! Discover your lucky block with a FULL ROLE PLAY TOWN!

+ Tiers of rare lucky blocks!
+ Easy to hard parkour
+ Coin System!
+ City for role play w/ SUPER CARS 
+ Single & Multiplayer

items.title: Crazy Bikers
items.creator: Team Visionary
items.description:
The sweet taste of candy is driving everyone in town crazy! This night will be unforgettable, don't forget to bring the bags with you! Knock on each door in the city and fill your pockets and purses with candy. So, don't miss this chance to greet your neighbors and hopefully they will prize you!

+ 1 free skin
+ 16 skins
+ By Team Visionary

items.title: Derpy Demons
items.creator: Yeggs
items.description:
Master skin crafters have made many demons of all sorts... but these ones came out a little funky! Colorful, fun, and a bit evil...

+ Includes 10 devilish derps!

items.title: Unicorn Castle
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Explore the flying castle where unicorns roam freely around the world! Be king or queen and rule this grand castle.

+ Brushes to caress your unicorn
+ More than 10 different unicorns
+ By 4KS Studios and Street Studios

items.title: Skyblock Millionaires
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Are you ready to play skyblock like a millionaire? This is your chance! Complete the challenges and defeat the dragon!

- Colibri Studios published by 4KS Studios

items.title: Rich Mobs
items.creator: The Lucky Petals
items.description:
Ready to live the luxurious life you were always meant to live? With these skins you can roleplay as a wealthy mob! Build a modern mansion with a huge pool and throw the biggest party ever!

- 10 skins

items.description:
Join in karate style with these guys!

- 12 Skins

- By UnderBlocks

Have fun with these amazing academy teens!

items.title: Space City
items.creator: Nitric Concepts
items.description:
Explore the futuristic city expansion on an alien planet! Using modern technology, we built a dome in the sky block by block. Space city awaits you, humankind's next greatest expansion.

+ Custom space city
+ Custom space biome
+ Survival expansion
